propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() contains four fragmented statements building an Agent kwargs dict spread across lines 371-392, 436-437, and 460-461 that must be consolidated into a single extracted function.

The post-call telemetry logic (logger.info for success path at lines 547-565 and usage_log.record spend at lines 583-599) must be extracted into separate functions while preserving the constraint that success logging occurs before finalization, which can raise.

The extracted functions must reside in a new module agent_call.py rather than structured_run.py because structured_run.py has only 9 lines of headroom under its 500-LOC assertion and cannot absorb the ~130-line extraction.

The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain in runner.py (not relocated to agent_call.py) because it is a runner-module global that the test suite patches via monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...), and moving it would silently defeat those patches.

After extraction, runner.py must be reduced from 699 LOC to under 800 (per .github/module-size-limit.txt), and the PydanticAIRunner.run() method body must be reduced from 342 LOC to approximately 60-90 LOC per ADR 0056 projections.
